name: fullops-meter
description: Shows the session's model, context and prompt cache and, in a FullOps repository, a pane of workers and reviews, the session's role, one-line cards for FullOps steps and what the coordinator still has out.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto decides from your settings and account (1 hour on a Claude subscription within its plan usage, else 5 minutes) and corrects itself from the request timing. 5m or 1h pins it.

warnContextPercent.title: Warn at context percent
warnContextPercent.description: Show a notice when the context window is at least this full.

showBand.title: Show the worker band above the prompt
showBand.description: The band shows coor worker dispatches when a FullOps run has any. Model, context and cache stay on the status line.

warnSeconds.title: Cache notice at (seconds)
warnSeconds.description: Show a notice, and turn the countdown to its warning state, this many seconds before the prompt cache lapses (at most half its lifetime). Leave time to run /compact.

compactAtTokens.title: Suggest /compact above (tokens)
compactAtTokens.description: When the cache is about to lapse and the prompt is at least this large, the band and notice suggest /compact while it is still cached. A judgement, not a documented figure.
